title: On the convergence of an adaptive denoiser driven iterative regularization with early stopping
summary: Solving inverse problems requires appropriate regularization techniques to ensure well-posedness and stability. In recent years, denoiser-driven methods have emerged as effective regularization strategies, achieving state-of-the-art performance in various imaging applications. However, their stability and convergence within iterative regularization frameworks remain largely unexplored.
